title: Surgeon's Subjugation Amulet

sources.title: Paralysing Critical
markers: | description = Once per [[Long Rest]], when scoring a [[Critical Hit]] on a [[List_of_Creature_Types#Humanoid|humanoid]], the wearer can {{Cond|Paralysed|Paralyse}} the target for 2 turns.

summary: Can paralyse a humanoid on a critical hit once per Long Rest.

fields.Paralysing Critical: On a critical hit against a humanoid, choose to Paralyse it for 2 turns, once per Long Rest. No save listed.
fields.Paralysed: Cannot move, act or react and automatically fails STR/DEX saves. Attacks from within 10 ft that hit are critical.
